messages.text: 14 claims open with you this week, 3 awaiting inspection reports our end.
Thanks. Send them when you have them. We adjudicate from the claim-system record, so they only hold things up where an exclusion turns on the report.
Ordered P-44120 and received P-44120-A. Do I claim against what I ordered or what I fitted?
What you fitted. 4.2 — where a part is superseded, the superseding part's price applies. Put P-44120-A on the claim.
